title: Node Type Catalog
description: Machine-readable registry of all available node types with metadata

categories.name: Triggers
categories.description: Workflow entry points that define how external data flows into the workflow

categories.name: Executors
categories.description: Nodes that execute work and produce outputs

categories.name: Control Flow
categories.description: Nodes that manage workflow execution flow

node_types.name: Manual Trigger
node_types.description: Workflow entry point triggered manually with user-provided inputs

node_types.name: Webhook Trigger
node_types.description: Workflow entry point triggered by incoming HTTP POST requests from external systems

node_types.name: Scheduled Trigger
node_types.description: Workflow entry point triggered on a time-based schedule using cron expressions or simple intervals

node_types.name: Script
node_types.description: Execute Python or Bash scripts with structured output

node_types.name: EDA Trigger
node_types.description: Workflow entry point triggered by Event-Driven Ansible events

node_types.name: Ansible Automation Platform Job Template
node_types.description: Launch Ansible Automation Platform job templates

node_types.name: Ansible Automation Platform Workflow Job Template
node_types.description: Launch Ansible Automation Platform workflow job templates

node_types.name: Task Agent
node_types.description: Execute task agent tasks with asynchronous completion

node_types.name: Approval
node_types.description: Human approval gate with timeout and conditional branching

node_types.name: Internal Activity
node_types.description: Execute built-in system operations as native Temporal activities

node_types.name: Converge
node_types.description: Wait for multiple parallel branches to complete (partially implemented)

node_types.name: Switch
node_types.description: Multi-case expression-based branching with first-match-wins evaluation

node_types.name: Wait
node_types.description: Pause workflow execution for a specified duration before continuing
